SELECT SEQ_TB_RESERVATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_RESERVATION ( reservation_id, member_no, branch_id, reserved_at, biz_type, purpose, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{dto.reservation_id}, #{dto.member_no}, #{dto.branch_id}, #{dto.reserved_at, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dto.biz_type}, #{dto.purpose}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.member_no, r.branch_id, r.reserved_at, r.biz_type, r.purpose, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, m.member_name AS member_name, b.branch_name AS branch_name FROM TB_RESERVATION r JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN TB_BRANCH b ON r.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.member_no, r.branch_id, r.reserved_at, r.biz_type, r.purpose, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, m.member_name AS member_name, b.branch_name AS branch_name FROM TB_RESERVATION r JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN TB_BRANCH b ON r.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(reserved_at, 'HH24:MI') AS slot FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND TRUNC(reserved_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
